sn2.20:1.1: ṭhito kho Anāthapiṇḍiko devaputto Bhagavato santike imā gāthāyo abhāsi || ||
sn2.20:6.2: idaṃ vatvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatth-eva antaradhāyi || || 3.
sn2.20:7.1: Atha kho Bhagavā tassā rattiyā accayena bhikkhū āmantesi || || 4.
sn2.20:7.2: Imam bhikkhave rattiṃ aññataro devaputto abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ Jetavanam obhāsetvā yenāham ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekam antam aṭṭhāsi ||
sn2.20:7.3: Ekam antaṃ ṭhito kho bhikkhave so devaputto mama santike imā gāthāyo abhāsi || || 5.
sn2.20:12.2: idam vatvā maṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatth-ev-antaradhāyīti || || 7.
sn2.20:13.1: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn2.20:13.2: So hi nūna bhante Anāthapiṇḍiko devaputto bhavissati ||
sn2.20:13.3: Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati āyasmante Sāriputte abhippasanno ahosīti || || 8.
sn2.20:13.4: Sādhu sādhu Ānanda || yāvatakaṃ kho Ānanda takkāya pattabbaṃ anuppattaṃ tayā ||
sn2.20:13.5: Anāthapiṇḍiko hi so Ānanda devaputto ti || ||
